content.comment_body: I bought three [product_name] units some time ago and am now trying to complete the setup using an SD card. Currently, the card holder doesn't close smoothly. Is this a known issue or am I experiencing something rare? It's odd that all three devices show the same problem. Without a card, the holders won't close either.
Welcome to the forum. Is the SD card not fully inserted? Or maybe it's placed upside down—the conductor tracks should face up and point to the right.

All cards are inserted properly; I double-checked. I'm not sure the photo is clear enough, but the holder can't be pushed further in. I previously purchased another version ([article_no]) and didn't encounter this issue. I hope you're not suggesting I use a pipe wrench.

When the holder is open, refer to the drawing on the side (next to the buttons) for correct microSD card insertion. It should click to lock when the microSD is in place, then you can close the holder. Push again to unlock the card. If it's not working, please share a clear photo showing the microSD properly positioned in the open holder.

It seems likely that the contact pins in the slot are bent, but this can only be confirmed by opening the upper part of the [product_name] housing to inspect them. It's surprising this happened across all devices. The card slot design is known to have shortcomings, and I'm interested to see if improvements are made in the upcoming [product_name] [version_no]. However, based on prior experience with [company_name], this is unlikely to have changed.

I've finally identified the problem: reinserting the card holder is trickier than expected. Since you can't see the position of the holder's pins, even a small misalignment can cause issues with the contact strip. It might help if the manufacturer added a longer internal guide on the PCB.

It's possible the slot is designed as an advanced interface for future expansions, not just memory cards. Otherwise, it would be beneficial to use an improved SD card holder in future versions, similar to past models. The current plastic holder isn't reliable if removed and inserted repeatedly. Regards, [user_name]
Hopefully, the developers are reading these discussions. As mentioned: why make things complicated when a simpler solution exists?

analysis.insight_summary: Users face persistent mechanical issues with closing the SD card holder on [product_name] devices, experienced across various units. The reinsertion mechanism lacks adequate visual guidance, often leading to misalignment with the contact pins—an ongoing concern. Contributors express dissatisfaction with the design, compare it unfavorably to older models, and suggest improvements for future product versions.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect an SD card holder that closes easily and securely without complicated steps or risk of misalignment.
